summary: Iteration 175 — Direct Google OAuth migration testing. Verified backend endpoints (POST /api/auth/google/callback direct + POST /api/auth/google/session legacy), Auth.jsx Google button redirect logic, AuthCallback.jsx dual-flow handling, and email/password regression. 8/8 backend tests PASS. 6/6 frontend flows PASS. Found ONE gap: direct-flow FAILURES are not recorded in db.oauth_health (only SUCCESS branch inserts). Google button correctly redirects to accounts.google.com (not auth.emergentagent.com) with all required params. AuthCallback correctly discriminates ?code=... (direct) vs #session_id=... (emergent) vs ?error=... (no backend call) vs empty (redirect /login).

minor.issue: Direct-flow FAILURE branches (401 on token exchange failure, 400 on missing email, etc.) do NOT insert into db.oauth_health. Only the success path (line 1173) writes flow='direct' events. Review request explicitly asked for tracking on 'eșec/succes'. Verified with pymongo: after triggering multiple failed callbacks with fake codes, db.oauth_health.find({flow:'direct'}) returns 0 documents.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: In /app/backend/routes/auth.py google_direct_callback, also insert oauth_health events for the failure branches (token 4xx, userinfo failures, timeouts) with outcome='failure' and flow='direct' — currently only success path is tracked. Wrap the raise HTTPException with a helper similar to _record_oauth_health used by the Emergent flow.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py:1109-1119 — HTTPException raised before any oauth_health.insert_one for the direct flow. The Emergent flow has _record_oauth_health helper (line 1342) that covers all branches. The direct-flow endpoint should reuse it for consistency and admin dashboard visibility.

auth.py:1170 — set_auth_cookies called before oauth_health insert. If oauth_health insert throws (line 1183 catches BLE001), user is still logged in — good. But note the try/except swallows the exception silently without logging (unlike _record_oauth_health at line 1348).
AuthCallback.jsx:29 — `error` param parsing is correct. Consider also surfacing `error_description` from Google (also returned) for richer messaging.
Auth.jsx:167 — Emergent fallback URL is hardcoded (`https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=...`). This is acceptable given the REMINDER comment at line 143.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted one TEST_iter175_<uuid>@example.com user via /api/auth/register + admin cleanup (best-effort).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The E2E Google OAuth click-through via accounts.google.com cannot be automated (Google consent required + preview URI not whitelisted → redirect_uri_mismatch). All local pieces (button URL, callback exchange, backend endpoint, flow discrimination) are verified. If Google Cloud Console whitelists the preview URI, redo the full E2E with a real Google account. The oauth_health tracking gap for direct-flow FAILURES is a documented minor issue — non-blocking.
